Off the Rails#072.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#073.src: Oh! The train's here! ...Uh, Guess I should catch you later?
Off the Rails#073.dst: 어머! 열차가 왔어요! ...어, 나중에 또 봬요?
Off the Rails#073.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#076.src: You want to talk? Sigh, fine. Fine, I guess.

Off the Rails#078.src: Ugh. Well, see, I'm from {p}. I... don't like it there. So I wanted to see what the {p} was like.
Off the Rails#078.dst: 으. 그러니까, 난 {p} 출신이야. 난... 거기가 싫어. 그래서 {p}은(는) 어떤지 보고 싶었지.
Off the Rails#078.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#079.src: Having been here yourself, I'm sure you understand well how that turned out. Now, I'm heading home.
Off the Rails#079.dst: 너도 여기 와 봤으니 결과가 어땠는지 잘 알겠지. 이제 집에 가는 길이야.
Off the Rails#079.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#080.src: Really, at this point, I don't know if anywhere in this province is worth seeing. It must all be like this.
Off the Rails#080.dst: 솔직히 이쯤 되니 이 지방에 볼 만한 곳이 있기나 한지 모르겠어. 다 이 모양이겠지.
Off the Rails#080.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#081.src: ...But enough about me. What do you want to say? (After Flinn's introduction)
Off the Rails#081.dst: ...내 얘긴 됐고. 무슨 말을 하고 싶은데? (Flinn 소개 후)
Off the Rails#081.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#082.src: Anything else? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#082.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#084.src: Sorry about that, I got... Madder, than expected... Anything else you'd like to discuss? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#084.dst: 미안, 생각보다... 더 화가 나서... 또 할 얘기 있어? ({p}에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#084.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#085.src: I chose this place because it was the cheapest ticket... I had to exchange so many materials for those weird emeralds they use here.
Off the Rails#085.dst: 표가 제일 싸서 여길 골랐어... 여기서 쓰는 이상한 에메랄드로 바꾸느라 재료를 엄청 내줘야 했지.
Off the Rails#085.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#086.src: I had high expectations, thought seeing another part of the province might restore my hopes... It didn't.
Off the Rails#086.dst: 기대가 컸어. 지방의 다른 곳을 보면 희망이 되살아날 줄 알았지... 아니더라.
Off the Rails#086.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#087.src: I hoped, at least, that the Festival here would be cool, and instead, it was a complete disaster. On top of that, I missed the one back home...
Off the Rails#087.dst: 적어도 여기 축제는 멋질 줄 알았는데, 완전히 엉망이었어. 게다가 고향 축제까지 놓쳤고...
Off the Rails#087.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#088.src: I'm just heading home. I guess I'll have to just... learn to like Auburn. Ugh...
Off the Rails#088.dst: 그냥 집에 가는 거야. 이제... Auburn을 좋아하는 법이나 배워야겠지. 으...
Off the Rails#088.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#089.src: This shirt? Ugh... I forgot about this stupid shirt.
Off the Rails#089.dst: 이 셔츠? 으... 이 멍청한 셔츠를 잊고 있었네.
Off the Rails#089.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#090.src: On the way here, some guy came up to me and begged on his knees for me to buy his shirt. It was hard to refuse... I felt bad...
Off the Rails#090.dst: 오는 길에 웬 남자가 무릎 꿇고 자기 셔츠를 사 달라고 빌더라. 거절하기 힘들었어... 마음이 안 좋아서...
Off the Rails#090.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#091.src: I guess "TC" stands for {p} City. For the record, I do NOT love {p} City.
Off the Rails#091.dst: "TC"는 {p} City인가 봐. 분명히 말하는데, 난 {p} City를 전혀 안 좋아해.
Off the Rails#091.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#092.src: In fact, this shirt doesn't even hold any value to me as a souvenier. I don't want to remember this trip.
Off the Rails#092.dst: 사실 이 셔츠는 기념품으로서의 가치도 없어. 이번 여행은 기억하고 싶지 않거든.
Off the Rails#092.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#093.src: I'm going to have to destroy it, or perhaps trade it for something. I never want to see it again.
Off the Rails#093.dst: 없애 버리든지 뭐랑 바꾸든지 해야겠어. 다신 보고 싶지 않아.
Off the Rails#093.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#095.src: It feels like we're living in squalor for no reason! You always hear these wonderful stories about other regions, like that the {p} have beautiful, huge lakes.
Off the Rails#095.dst: 우린 아무 이유도 없이 빈민가에 사는 것 같아! 다른 지역 얘긴 늘 멋지잖아. {p}엔 아름답고 거대한 호수가 있다든가.
Off the Rails#095.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#096.src: If that's even true, why can't we get some of that water? Why must we put up with the pathetic trickle we get from the dam?
Off the Rails#096.dst: 그게 사실이라면 왜 우린 그 물을 좀 못 받는 거야? 왜 댐에서 졸졸 흐르는 그 초라한 물로 버텨야 하냐고?
Off the Rails#096.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#097.src: And yet, everyone back home is just so... Okay??? With it??? They think the government couldn't wrong them. They build shrines to the Queen in their homes!
Off the Rails#097.dst: 그런데 고향 사람들은 다들 그냥... 괜찮대??? 그걸로??? 정부가 자기들한테 잘못할 리 없대. 집에 여왕 제단까지 차려!
Off the Rails#097.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#098.src: It's just so... Frustrating!!! Why can't they see things the way I do??? The region itself is mostly fine, it's the people I can't stand!
Off the Rails#098.dst: 진짜... 답답해!!! 왜 다들 나처럼 못 보는 거야??? 지역 자체는 대체로 괜찮아, 참을 수 없는 건 사람들이야!
Off the Rails#098.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#099.src: I don't even believe those stories anymore though... I think everywhere is just awful in its own way.
Off the Rails#099.dst: 근데 이젠 그 얘기들도 안 믿어... 어디든 저마다 끔찍한 것 같아.
Off the Rails#099.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#100.src: We were always sold this idea of the {p} as this beautiful place where proud workers labored for the Queen amidst beautiful crop fields... You've seen it, haven't you?
Off the Rails#100.dst: 우린 늘 {p}이(가) 자랑스러운 일꾼들이 아름다운 밭에서 여왕을 위해 일하는 멋진 곳이라고 들었어... 너도 봤지?
Off the Rails#100.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#101.src: I bet everywhere is just as bad. I just don't know what to think of anything anymore. It all feels like a lie. But maybe I'm just asking for too much, I don't know...
Off the Rails#101.dst: 분명 어디든 똑같이 나쁠 거야. 이제 뭘 어떻게 생각해야 할지 모르겠어. 전부 거짓말 같아. 근데 내가 너무 많은 걸 바라는 건지도, 모르겠다...
Off the Rails#101.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#102.src: Other people? The girl tried talking to me, but she left me alone when she realized I didn't want to talk.
Off the Rails#102.dst: 다른 사람들? 그 여자애가 말을 걸었는데, 내가 얘기하기 싫어하는 걸 알고 내버려 두더라.
Off the Rails#102.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#103.src: And that other guy? I didn't notice him until just now.
Off the Rails#103.dst: 그 다른 남자? 방금까지 있는 줄도 몰랐어.
Off the Rails#103.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#104.src: ...Train's here. Stop talking to me, please...
Off the Rails#104.speaker: Flinn

Off the Rails#105.src: Hey... Didn't I just ask you to not cause trouble? Could you stop that, please?
Off the Rails#105.dst: 이봐요... 방금 말썽 피우지 말라고 했잖아요? 그만 좀 해 줄래요?
Off the Rails#105.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#107.src: Listen. I don't feel like calling the guards over, okay? I'm asking you to please stop.
Off the Rails#107.dst: 들어 봐요. 경비병 부르기 싫거든요? 제발 그만해 달라는 거예요.
Off the Rails#107.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#108.src: You're really annoying everyone here, including me. Thanks.
Off the Rails#108.dst: 여기 있는 사람들 전부 짜증 나게 하고 있어요, 나까지요. 고마워요.
Off the Rails#108.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#109.src: Sigh... Whatever, it's not like they're paying me enough to care...
Off the Rails#109.dst: 하아... 됐다, 신경 쓸 만큼 월급을 받는 것도 아니고...
Off the Rails#109.speaker: Ticket Collector

Off the Rails#111.src: Step aside, citizens. We're here on important business.

Off the Rails#112.src: The general of the Constables Division..? I wonder what's going on...
Off the Rails#112.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#113.src: Keep your nose out of our matters, citizen. Our activities will have no impact on your trip.
Off the Rails#113.dst: 우리 일에 코 박지 마라, 시민. 우리 활동은 너희 여행에 아무 영향도 없을 거다.

Off the Rails#115.src: Hey! What's the holdup? All aboard! Come on!
Off the Rails#115.dst: 이봐요! 왜 지체해요? 모두 탑승! 어서요!

Off the Rails#116.src: Hello passenger! I hope that the subway experience has been to your liking.
Off the Rails#116.dst: 안녕하세요, 승객님! 지하철 여행이 마음에 드셨길 바랍니다.

Off the Rails#117.src: I am Telati, the attendant for your journey today. I am sorry I did not say hello when verifying your stamp, I was a little, uh, shocked by how many people were taking the train today.
Off the Rails#117.dst: 저는 오늘 여정을 담당할 승무원 Telati입니다. 도장 확인 때 인사를 못 드려 죄송해요. 오늘 탑승객이 너무 많아서, 어, 좀 놀랐거든요.
Off the Rails#117.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#118.src: We don't get passengers often, to be honest with you, so to have even this many... That was a surprise. Not to mention General Levi being here, too.
Off the Rails#118.dst: 솔직히 평소엔 승객이 별로 없어서 이만큼만 있어도... 놀라운 일이에요. Levi 장군님까지 타셨으니 말할 것도 없죠.
Off the Rails#118.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#119.src: Anyway, we should be arriving in {p} in an hour or two. Until then, feel free to talk with your fellow passengers, or take a nap.
Off the Rails#119.dst: 아무튼 한두 시간 뒤면 {p}에 도착할 거예요. 그동안 다른 승객분들과 얘기를 나누거나 한숨 주무세요.
Off the Rails#119.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#120.src: I hope you have a good trip! And, if there's any issues, do not be afraid to speak with me.
Off the Rails#120.dst: 좋은 여행 되세요! 그리고 문제가 생기면 망설이지 말고 말씀해 주세요.
Off the Rails#120.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#121.src: Explore the train. Return to your seat at [-{~}, {~}, {~}] when done.
Off the Rails#121.dst: 열차를 둘러보세요. 다 보면 [-{~}, {~}, {~}]의 자리로 돌아가세요.

Off the Rails#122.src: Oh, hello there, passenger. Is something the matter?
Off the Rails#122.dst: 아, 안녕하세요, 승객님. 무슨 일 있으세요?
Off the Rails#122.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#123.src: ...You just want to chat? You know what, sure, it could be a nice break from my busywork.
Off the Rails#123.dst: ...그냥 얘기하고 싶으시다고요? 좋아요, 잡무에서 잠깐 쉬어 가는 것도 괜찮겠네요.
Off the Rails#123.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#124.src: As I told you before, my name's Telati. I'm... the only staffer on the train today. Besides the driver, Cusef, but he's busy, well, driving.
Off the Rails#124.dst: 아까 말씀드렸듯이 전 Telati예요. 오늘 열차의 유일한 직원이죠... 기관사 Cusef도 있지만, 그 사람은, 음, 운전하느라 바빠요.
Off the Rails#124.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#125.src: That means I'm the only person here to attend our many passengers today. Again, we don't usually get this many.
Off the Rails#125.dst: 그러니까 오늘 이 많은 승객을 응대하는 사람은 저 하나예요. 다시 말하지만 평소엔 이렇게 많지 않아요.
Off the Rails#125.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#126.src: It's... It's okay though. Everyone seems fairly content. Besides that Cemor guy, at least.
Off the Rails#126.dst: 그래도... 그래도 괜찮아요. 다들 꽤 만족하시는 것 같아요. 적어도 그 Cemor라는 분만 빼면요.
Off the Rails#126.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#127.src: Enough about that though. What would you like to talk about? (After Telati's introduction)
Off the Rails#127.dst: 그 얘긴 그만하고요. 무슨 얘기를 하고 싶으세요? (Telati 소개 후)
Off the Rails#127.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#128.src: ...Anything else to say? (When the dialogue options reappear)
Off the Rails#128.dst: ...또 하실 말씀 있으세요? (선택지가 다시 나올 때)
Off the Rails#128.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#129.src: Anything wrong? Or do you just want to chat? (Subsequent conversations with Telati)
Off the Rails#129.dst: 무슨 문제 있으세요? 아니면 그냥 얘기하시게요? (이후 Telati와의 대화)
Off the Rails#129.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#130.src: ...It's okay. I can handle it... Anything else to say? (After asking about the Other staff)
Off the Rails#130.dst: ...괜찮아요. 감당할 수 있어요... 또 하실 말씀 있으세요? (다른 직원에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#130.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#131.src: ...Whatever... Anything else to say? (After asking about Cemor)
Off the Rails#131.dst: ...뭐 됐고... 또 하실 말씀 있으세요? (Cemor에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#131.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#132.src: ...Perhaps I shouldn't have let that slip... Uhm... Anything else to say...? (After asking about his Thoughts on the train)
Off the Rails#132.dst: ...괜히 입을 잘못 놀렸나 봐요... 음... 또 하실 말씀 있으세요...? (열차에 대한 그의 생각을 물은 후)
Off the Rails#132.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#133.src: There aren't many of us, really. Each train usually has only {~} staffers- a driver and {~} attendants.
Off the Rails#133.dst: 사실 우린 인원이 많지 않아요. 열차마다 보통 직원은 {~}명뿐이에요. 기관사 하나에 승무원 {~}명요.
Off the Rails#133.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#134.src: The team for this particular train is Cusef the driver, plus Zathie and I.
Off the Rails#134.dst: 이 열차 팀은 기관사 Cusef, 그리고 Zathie와 저예요.
Off the Rails#134.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#135.src: This is typically enough, as the trains aren't very busy. Frankly, I don't know why they bother having this many carriages.
Off the Rails#135.dst: 열차가 그리 붐비지 않으니 보통은 그걸로 충분해요. 솔직히 객차를 왜 이렇게 많이 다는지 모르겠어요.
Off the Rails#135.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#136.src: It's usually only Aelumians and Highlanders who can afford trips, and, well... Most of those guys don't seem interested in seeing other regions.
Off the Rails#136.dst: 여행할 여유가 있는 건 대개 Aelumia 사람과 고지대 사람뿐인데, 음... 그분들은 대부분 다른 지역엔 관심이 없어 보여요.
Off the Rails#136.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#137.src: This time of year is actually the exception, since the Festivals are on. But, having spoken to a few passengers, none seem to be travelling for that at all.
Off the Rails#137.dst: 사실 축제가 열리는 이맘때는 예외예요. 그런데 승객 몇 분과 얘기해 보니 축제 때문에 가는 분은 아무도 없더라고요.
Off the Rails#137.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#138.src: For today's trip to have so many people - and such a diverse set too - is an anomaly. It's unfortunate timing, too, since Zathie's on break.
Off the Rails#138.dst: 오늘처럼 사람이 이렇게 많고, 게다가 이렇게 다양한 건 이례적이에요. 하필 Zathie가 휴가 중이라 타이밍도 안 좋고요.
Off the Rails#138.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#139.src: We were dealing with all the expected extra traffic from the Auburn Festival being on, and she burnt herself preparing a meal, so she got a couple days off.
Off the Rails#139.dst: Auburn 축제 때문에 예상대로 늘어난 승객을 감당하던 중에 그녀가 식사 준비하다 화상을 입어서 며칠 휴가를 받았어요.
Off the Rails#139.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#140.src: I thought it'd be fine since the Auburn Festival's wrapped up, but... I guess there's still a lot of interest in going there?
Off the Rails#140.dst: Auburn 축제가 끝났으니 괜찮을 줄 알았는데... 아직도 거기 가려는 사람이 많은가 봐요?
Off the Rails#140.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#141.src: Ah, my home. It may surprise you, but I'm from the Roughw- er- {p}.
Off the Rails#141.dst: 아, 제 고향요. 놀라실지도 모르지만 전 Roughw- 어- {p} 출신이에요.
Off the Rails#141.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#142.src: I'm lucky to have a job such as this, living where I do. The conditions aboard the train are heavenly compared to where my neighbors work.
Off the Rails#142.dst: 제가 사는 곳을 생각하면 이런 일자리를 얻은 건 행운이에요. 열차 안 환경은 이웃들 일터에 비하면 천국이죠.
Off the Rails#142.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#143.src: ...I do wonder why they can't share this quality of life. I suppose there must be a reason for it; I trust Her Majesty's judgement.
Off the Rails#143.dst: ...왜 이런 삶의 질을 나눌 수 없는지 궁금하긴 해요. 분명 이유가 있겠죠. 전 여왕 폐하의 판단을 믿어요.
Off the Rails#143.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#144.src: Ah, him. Yes, he's the Highlander sat in the dining carriage.
Off the Rails#144.dst: 아, 그분요. 네, 식당칸에 앉아 계신 고지대 분이에요.
Off the Rails#144.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#145.src: He seems... needy. No- maybe that's just selfish of me to say.
Off the Rails#145.dst: 그분은... 좀 까다로워요. 아니, 제가 이기적인 말을 하는 건지도요.
Off the Rails#145.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#146.src: He keeps asking me to prepare him some specific meal, and... listen. The customer is always right, and all, but...
Off the Rails#146.dst: 자꾸 특정한 요리를 만들어 달라고 하시는데... 들어 보세요. 손님은 왕이라지만, 그래도...
Off the Rails#146.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#147.src: I'm not the chef on this train. That's Zathie. I'm scared of messing up the recipe, and also just generally dislike cooking.
Off the Rails#147.dst: 전 이 열차 요리사가 아니에요. 요리사는 Zathie죠. 레시피를 망칠까 봐 무섭고, 애초에 요리를 싫어해요.
Off the Rails#147.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#148.src: So... I'm hanging out here as far away from him as possible, hoping he just... forgets about it.
Off the Rails#148.dst: 그래서... 그분한테서 최대한 멀리 떨어져 여기 있는 거예요. 그냥... 잊어버리시길 바라면서요.

Off the Rails#307.dst: 왜 열차가 지하로만 다니는지 궁금해요. 안전 때문일까요?
Off the Rails#307.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#308.src: Having grown up in Aelumia, I'm pretty familiar with the Guard's upper ranks. There's military parades all the time, you know!
Off the Rails#308.dst: Aelumia에서 자라서 경비대 고위층은 꽤 잘 알아요. 거기선 늘 군사 퍼레이드를 하거든요!
Off the Rails#308.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#309.src: That scary lady we saw back there? That was General Levi, the leader of the Constables Division.
Off the Rails#309.dst: 아까 본 그 무서운 여자분요? Levi 장군님이에요. 치안대의 수장이죠.
Off the Rails#309.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#310.src: She took on the role a few years ago, when the previous General, General Daimyo, stepped down. She's pretty cool, it was a nice surprise seeing her here!
Off the Rails#310.dst: 몇 년 전 전임인 Daimyo 장군님이 물러나면서 그 자리를 맡으셨어요. 꽤 멋진 분이라 여기서 뵌 게 반가운 놀라움이었어요!
Off the Rails#310.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#311.src: I do wonder what calls for such urgency though... Usually, she has her Commanders handle most things. For her to need to handle something personally, and on a civilian train...
Off the Rails#311.dst: 그런데 뭐가 그렇게 급한지 궁금해요... 보통은 사령관들한테 대부분 맡기시거든요. 직접 나서야 하는 데다 민간 열차까지 타다니...
Off the Rails#311.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#312.src: ...Well, she did ask that we stay out of it, so I guess I shouldn't get too curious.
Off the Rails#312.dst: ...음, 끼어들지 말라고 하셨으니 너무 궁금해하면 안 되겠죠.
Off the Rails#312.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#313.src: I talked to a few people when I first boarded, but now I'm just going to relax. I'll probably talk to more people later when I get bored.
Off the Rails#313.dst: 처음 탔을 땐 몇 명이랑 얘기했는데, 지금은 그냥 쉬려고요. 나중에 심심해지면 더 얘기하겠죠.
Off the Rails#313.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#314.src: The first person I tried talking to was the attendant, Telati, but he seemed... stressed, so I just let him be.
Off the Rails#314.dst: 처음 말을 건 사람은 승무원 Telati였는데, 좀... 스트레스받은 것 같아서 그냥 내버려 뒀어요.
Off the Rails#314.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#315.src: Then... See her over there? The girl with the glasses? That's Demma, one of my dad's students. We spoke for a bit, it was nice to see her!
Off the Rails#315.dst: 그리고... 저기 저분 보여요? 안경 쓴 여자분요? 우리 아빠 학생인 Demma예요. 잠깐 얘기했는데 만나서 반가웠어요!
Off the Rails#315.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#316.src: Lastly, I tried speaking to the posh guy in the canteen, but... he said he was at a good part in his book, so I just left him alone.
Off the Rails#316.dst: 마지막으로 식당칸의 귀티 나는 남자분한테 말을 걸었는데... 책에서 재밌는 부분을 읽는 중이라고 해서 그냥 뒀어요.
Off the Rails#316.speaker: Maddison

Off the Rails#317.src: Sigh, what is it? You want to talk? To me?
Off the Rails#317.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#318.src: ...Fine. I suppose I can indulge. But you had better leave me to read my book in peace when you're done.
Off the Rails#318.dst: ...좋네. 어울려 주지. 대신 끝나면 조용히 책 읽게 내버려 두게.
Off the Rails#318.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#319.src: I am Cemor, of House Efelu, a noble house of small repute, though soon it shall surely rise.
Off the Rails#319.dst: 난 Efelu 가문의 Cemor일세. 아직 명성은 크지 않은 귀족 가문이지만, 곧 분명 떠오를 걸세.
Off the Rails#319.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#320.src: I'm travelling from my home, the {p}, to Auburn. Why? Well, I booked a ticket to go to the Festival of the Queen, but... for the wrong date.
Off the Rails#320.dst: 고향인 {p}에서 Auburn으로 가는 길이네. 왜냐고? 음, 여왕 축제에 가려고 표를 예매했는데... 날짜를 잘못 골랐지.
Off the Rails#320.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#321.src: I didn't want that money to go to waste, so I'm going to go and visit {p} anyway. There's probably some festival left to experience.
Off the Rails#321.dst: 그 돈을 날리긴 싫어서 어쨌든 {p}에 가 보기로 했네. 즐길 만한 축제가 좀 남아 있겠지.
Off the Rails#321.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#322.src: But enough about little old me. What do you want to talk about? (After Cemor's introduction)
Off the Rails#322.dst: 이 늙은이 얘긴 이쯤 하지. 무슨 얘길 하고 싶나? (Cemor 소개 후)
Off the Rails#322.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#323.src: What is it now? (Subsequent conversations with Cemor)
Off the Rails#323.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#324.src: But let us move on from that. What else have you to discuss? (After asking about the Book)
Off the Rails#324.dst: 그 얘긴 이쯤 하세. 또 논할 게 있나? (책에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#324.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#325.src: Let us move on. What else would you like to speak about? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#325.dst: 넘어가세. 또 무슨 얘길 하고 싶나? ({p}에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#325.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#326.src: Moving on. What else is there to speak of? (After asking about the {p})
Off the Rails#326.dst: 넘어가지. 또 할 얘기가 있나? ({p}에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#326.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#327.src: ...Anywho. Anything else? (After asking about the Train)
Off the Rails#327.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#328.src: Ah, yes. The book. It's very good, I'm glad I chose to bring it with me.
Off the Rails#328.dst: 아, 그래. 책 말인가. 아주 좋네. 가져오길 잘했어.
Off the Rails#328.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#329.src: It's called "The Long-Winded and Painful Death of Greenie S. Sweenville," which, I hope, speaks for itself.
Off the Rails#329.dst: 제목은 "Greenie S. Sweenville의 장황하고 고통스러운 죽음"이지. 제목만으로 충분히 설명되길 바라네.
Off the Rails#329.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#330.src: One of the members of my book club back in {p} recommended it to me. I'm glad they did- it's a beautiful story.
Off the Rails#330.dst: {p}의 독서 모임 회원이 추천해 줬지. 추천해 줘서 다행이야. 아름다운 이야기거든.
Off the Rails#330.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#331.src: It's a shame... The Auburn Festival is usually quite good. A few of us Highlanders go down to Auburn to see it.
Off the Rails#331.dst: 안타깝군... Auburn 축제는 보통 꽤 괜찮거든. 우리 고지대 사람들 몇몇은 그걸 보러 Auburn까지 내려가지.
Off the Rails#331.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#332.src: They have games, beautiful cuisine, and a band... Who knew Auburn could put on such a wonderful show.
Off the Rails#332.dst: 놀이도 있고, 훌륭한 요리에, 악단까지... Auburn이 그런 멋진 행사를 열 줄 누가 알았겠나.
Off the Rails#332.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#333.src: I think it's that Sovereign Zhiraok- I hear he busies himself trying to atone for his family's failures. I'd feel bad, if not for him being a Nasin.
Off the Rails#333.dst: 아마 그 Zhiraok 군주 덕이겠지. 가문의 실패를 속죄하느라 바쁘다더군. 그가 Nasin만 아니었어도 딱하게 여겼을 걸세.
Off the Rails#333.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#334.src: Our own festival is quite a sight to see, too. I'd recommend visiting, but they make those tickets too expensive for the lower regions, don't they?
Off the Rails#334.dst: 우리 축제도 꽤 볼만하지. 가 보라고 권하고 싶지만, 아래 지역 사람들한텐 표가 너무 비싸지 않나?
Off the Rails#334.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#336.src: Ah, the {p}. Gorgeous place, perhaps the real crown jewel of Fruma.
Off the Rails#336.dst: 아, {p}. 멋진 곳이지. 어쩌면 Fruma의 진정한 보석일세.
Off the Rails#336.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#337.src: I question why the Queen doesn't come and live amongst us. Perhaps she fears the people, hence her home being a fortress.
Off the Rails#337.dst: 여왕께서 왜 우리 곁에 와 살지 않으시는지 의문이네. 백성이 두려우신 걸지도. 그러니 거처가 요새겠지.
Off the Rails#337.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#338.src: Our Sovereign, Majin... He spends far too much of his time trying to outcompete that Nasin, as would a Thalas.
Off the Rails#338.dst: 우리 군주 Majin은... Thalas 가문답게 그 Nasin을 이기려고 시간을 너무 많이 쓰네.
Off the Rails#338.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#339.src: He should keep his sights on his own region... The Nasins are already disgraced; what does he have to prove?
Off the Rails#339.dst: 자기 지역에나 신경 써야지... Nasin 가문은 이미 망신을 당했는데, 뭘 더 증명하려는 건가?
Off the Rails#339.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#340.src: It's... alright, I suppose. I've had worse train rides.
Off the Rails#340.dst: 그럭저럭... 괜찮네. 이보다 나쁜 열차도 타 봤지.
Off the Rails#340.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#341.src: I've also had better train rides, though... Usually, there is another caterer.
Off the Rails#341.dst: 하지만 더 좋은 열차도 타 봤네... 보통은 조리 담당이 한 명 더 있거든.
Off the Rails#341.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#342.src: We'll see how the one caterer does preparing my meal. It's my favourite, whole roast Grookiva, and that's not particularly hard to prepare, so...
Off the Rails#342.dst: 하나뿐인 조리 담당이 내 식사를 어떻게 준비할지 두고 보지. 내가 제일 좋아하는 Grookiva 통구이인데, 그리 어려운 요리도 아니니...
Off the Rails#342.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#343.src: Ugh. Then leave me to my book in peace, please.
Off the Rails#343.dst: 으. 그럼 조용히 책 읽게 내버려 두게.
Off the Rails#343.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#345.src: ...Oh, Harvin, GODDAMNIT HARVIN... We're NOT gettin' let off the hook for this one! We're SCREWED.
Off the Rails#345.dst: ...아, Harvin, 젠장 HARVIN... 이번엔 절대 안 봐줄 거야! 우린 망했다고.
Off the Rails#345.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#346.src: ...God Maury, with a messup this bad, they'll send us to Deraj for sure! You know what they do to people in Deraj!!!
Off the Rails#346.dst: ...세상에 Maury, 이렇게 크게 망쳤으니 분명 Deraj로 보낼 거야! Deraj에서 사람들한테 무슨 짓 하는지 알잖아!!!
Off the Rails#346.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#349.src: This is YOUR fault, ya idiot! Where the hell were YOU when I was takin' a nap?
Off the Rails#349.dst: 이건 네 잘못이야, 멍청아! 내가 낮잠 잘 때 넌 대체 어디 있었어?
Off the Rails#349.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#350.src: Yeah? What were YOU doing napping on the job? What else was I supposed to do when I needed the bathroom?
Off the Rails#350.dst: 그래? 넌 근무 중에 왜 낮잠을 잤는데? 화장실이 급한데 나더러 어쩌라고?
Off the Rails#350.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#353.src: If we catch the perpetrator, we'll be... redeemed! Yeah!
Off the Rails#353.dst: 범인을 잡으면 우린... 명예 회복이야! 그래!
Off the Rails#353.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#354.src: Good idea, but how the hell're we gonna catch them? That sounds... hard.
Off the Rails#354.dst: 좋은 생각인데, 대체 어떻게 잡아? 그거... 어려워 보이는데.
Off the Rails#354.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#358.src: Ye're under arrest for the murder of General Levi, punk!
Off the Rails#358.dst: Levi 장군 살해 혐의로 체포한다, 이 녀석!
Off the Rails#358.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#360.src: Evidence? Heh, They'll believe it - ye're suspicious-lookin', and have some oddd tools on yer person. Don't think we haven't seen 'em.
Off the Rails#360.dst: 증거? 헤, 믿을 거야. 넌 수상하게 생겼고, 이상한 도구도 지니고 있잖아. 우리가 못 본 줄 알아?
Off the Rails#360.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#361.src: Yeah, what region are you from, anyway? The Secret {p} Civilization? Ha! NOBODY goes around dressed like you.
Off the Rails#361.dst: 그래, 대체 어느 지역 출신인데? 비밀의 {p} 문명? 하! 그렇게 입고 다니는 사람은 아무도 없어.
Off the Rails#361.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#362.src: Hey! You can't just accuse them without evidence! That's not fair!
Off the Rails#362.dst: 잠깐! 증거도 없이 그렇게 몰아가면 안 되죠! 불공평해요!
Off the Rails#362.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#363.src: Do ya wanna be put down as an accomplice in the murder? Shut yer trap!
Off the Rails#363.dst: 살인 공범으로 올라가고 싶어? 입 닥쳐!
Off the Rails#363.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#364.src: But- but they were asleep the entire time! I saw it!
Off the Rails#364.dst: 하, 하지만 그 사람 내내 자고 있었어요! 제가 봤다고요!
Off the Rails#364.speaker: Malic

Off the Rails#365.src: ...Egh... Fine... Tell ya what. New idea.
Off the Rails#365.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#366.src: You n' I... We're gonna play a little game.
Off the Rails#366.dst: 너랑 나... 작은 게임을 하나 하자고.
Off the Rails#366.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#367.src: If you can prove yer innocence before the train reaches the station... Ye're free to go. Otherwise? We go with Plan A.
Off the Rails#367.dst: 열차가 역에 닿기 전에 결백을 증명하면... 가도 좋아. 못 하면? 원래 계획대로 간다.
Off the Rails#367.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#368.src: All of you, out. This is private business. Get back to yer seats.
Off the Rails#368.dst: 다들 나가. 이건 사적인 일이야. 자리로 돌아가.
Off the Rails#368.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#369.src: Alright. Uhh. The best way to prove that ye're innocent would probably be to figure out who actually did it.
Off the Rails#369.dst: 좋아. 어. 결백을 증명하는 제일 좋은 방법은 아마 진짜 범인을 찾아내는 거겠지.
Off the Rails#369.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#370.src: If yer gonna be playin' detective, you're gonna want somewhere to jot yer findings, right? Where are we gonna get ya somethin' like that...
Off the Rails#370.dst: 탐정 노릇을 하려면 알아낸 걸 적을 데가 있어야겠지? 그런 걸 어디서 구해 주나...
Off the Rails#370.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#371.src: Don't worry, Maury, I have just the thing!
Off the Rails#371.dst: 걱정 마, Maury, 딱 좋은 게 있어!
Off the Rails#371.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#372.src: Yer notebook? The one you were supposed ta use for documentin' suspicious activity?
Off the Rails#372.dst: 네 수첩? 수상한 활동 기록하는 데 써야 했던 그거?
Off the Rails#372.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#373.src: Yeah, I never bothered with it.
Off the Rails#373.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#375.src: Uh. Anyway. You. Yeah. A good place to start yer investigation would be the scene of the crime, probably.
Off the Rails#375.dst: 어. 아무튼. 너. 그래. 수사는 아마 범행 현장에서 시작하는 게 좋을 거야.
Off the Rails#375.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#376.src: Go poke around at the body and see what ya can find.
Off the Rails#376.dst: 시체 좀 뒤져 보고 뭐가 나오나 봐.
Off the Rails#376.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#377.src: Inspect the General's corpse to find clues.

Off the Rails#379.src: Hey, do you need that? Is that gonna help you with the case?
Off the Rails#379.dst: 야, 그거 필요해? 사건 해결에 도움 돼?
Off the Rails#379.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#381.src: Interestin' evidence... this seems highly premeditated, if ya ask me...
Off the Rails#381.dst: 흥미로운 증거네... 내가 보기엔 치밀하게 계획한 것 같은데...
Off the Rails#381.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#382.src: Well, anyway, that ain't for us ta worry about. You're gonna figure out who did this.
Off the Rails#382.dst: 뭐, 아무튼 그건 우리가 신경 쓸 일이 아니지. 누가 했는지는 네가 알아내야 해.
Off the Rails#382.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#383.src: Ya should go around an' talk to yer fellow passengers, see if they got any dirt. Ya might also spot some physical evidence along the way...
Off the Rails#383.dst: 돌아다니면서 다른 승객들이랑 얘기해 봐. 뭐 캐낼 게 있나 보라고. 가다가 물증도 찾을지 모르고...
Off the Rails#383.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#384.src: Hey, Maury... How are we gonna stop them from just accusing someone random? There would be no point to any of this, and we'd might as well just arrest them instead...
Off the Rails#384.dst: 야, Maury... 아무나 막 지목하는 건 어떻게 막아? 그럼 이게 다 의미가 없잖아. 차라리 저 사람을 체포하는 게 낫지...
Off the Rails#384.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#386.src: Ye're gonna have to find some compelling pieces of evidence, I guess. We'll say {~}.
Off the Rails#386.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#387.src: Once ya have {~} pieces of strong evidence, come back ta us and make yer accusation.
Off the Rails#387.dst: 확실한 증거 {~}개를 찾으면 우리한테 와서 범인을 지목해.
Off the Rails#387.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#388.src: Look around and interrogate passengers to find at least {~} pieces of strong evidence.
Off the Rails#388.dst: 주변을 조사하고 승객들을 심문해 확실한 증거를 최소 {~}개 찾으세요.

Off the Rails#389.src: * Left-Click to pick up or drop pieces
Off the Rails#389.speaker: Controls

Off the Rails#390.src: * Click to select a column or row
Off the Rails#390.speaker: Controls

Off the Rails#391.src: Oh, it's you again. You... Those guards were wrong, right? ...Would they accuse someone randomly..?
Off the Rails#391.dst: 아, 또 오셨네요. 그... 경비병들이 틀렸죠? ...아무나 막 몰아가진 않겠죠..?
Off the Rails#391.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#393.src: Well... I guess those guards are having you hunt for who else could've done it, so I suppose it is my duty as a citizen to assist.
Off the Rails#393.dst: 음... 경비병들이 누가 범인일지 찾으라고 시킨 거죠? 그럼 시민으로서 돕는 게 제 의무겠네요.
Off the Rails#393.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#394.src: Besides, taking questions from you might help me not think about certain things. Like that I'm going to have to clean up that body later.
Off the Rails#394.dst: 게다가 질문에 답하다 보면 다른 생각을 안 할 수도 있고요. 예를 들면 이따 그 시신을 치워야 한다는 거요.
Off the Rails#394.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#396.src: Oh, you're the one from the murder scene, aren't you? The one those guards accused?
Off the Rails#396.dst: 아, 살인 현장에 있던 분이시죠? 경비병들이 몰아세운 그분요?
Off the Rails#396.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#397.src: ...You didn't actually do it, right? ...Would guards accuse someone randomly..?
Off the Rails#397.dst: ...정말 한 건 아니죠? ...경비병이 아무나 막 몰아가진 않겠죠..?
Off the Rails#397.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#399.src: Well... I guess those guards are having you hunt for who else could've done it, so I suppose it is my duty as a citizen to assist.
Off the Rails#399.dst: 음... 경비병들이 누가 범인일지 찾으라고 시킨 거죠? 그럼 시민으로서 돕는 게 제 의무겠네요.
Off the Rails#399.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#400.src: As I told you back when you boarded, my name's Telati. I'm... the only staffer on the train today. Besides the driver, Cusef, but he's busy, well, driving.
Off the Rails#400.dst: 탑승하실 때 말씀드렸듯이 전 Telati예요. 오늘 열차의 유일한 직원이죠... 기관사 Cusef도 있지만, 그 사람은, 음, 운전하느라 바빠요.
Off the Rails#400.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#401.src: That means I'm the only person here to attend our many passengers today. And... The only person here to deal with this horrible crisis. To clean up the mess.
Off the Rails#401.dst: 그러니까 오늘 이 많은 승객을 응대하는 사람은 저 하나예요. 그리고... 이 끔찍한 사태를 처리할 사람도 저 하나고요. 뒤처리까지요.
Off the Rails#401.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#402.src: It's... It's... Sigh. I'm stressed, alright?
Off the Rails#402.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#404.src: ...What questions do you have? (After initial conversation)
Off the Rails#404.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#405.src: Anything wrong? Or do you have more questions? (Subsequent conversations with Telati)
Off the Rails#405.dst: 무슨 문제 있으세요? 아니면 더 물어볼 게 있으세요? (이후 Telati와의 대화)
Off the Rails#405.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#406.src: Any more questions? (After asking about what Telati saw before the murder)
Off the Rails#406.dst: 더 궁금한 거 있으세요? (살인 전에 Telati가 본 것을 물은 후)
Off the Rails#406.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#407.src: Anything else to say...? (After choosing any purple dialogue option)
Off the Rails#407.dst: 또 하실 말씀 있으세요...? (보라색 선택지를 고른 후)
Off the Rails#407.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#408.src: Ah, of course. Staffing the train, I've seen a lot today. Let me recount.
Off the Rails#408.dst: 아, 물론이죠. 열차 근무하면서 오늘 많은 걸 봤어요. 다시 떠올려 볼게요.
Off the Rails#408.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#409.src: Well, for starters... I was loitering in this carriage, just trying to avoid Cemor. I... didn't want to make his meal.
Off the Rails#409.dst: 음, 우선... 전 Cemor 씨를 피하려고 이 칸에서 서성이고 있었어요. 그... 그분 식사를 만들기 싫었거든요.
Off the Rails#409.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#410.src: Yes, it was wrong of me. I ought to apologise to him... Anyway, he showed up here to go to the bathroom, so I quickly left before he could talk to me.
Off the Rails#410.dst: 네, 제가 잘못했죠. 사과드려야 하는데... 아무튼 그분이 화장실 가려고 여기 오셔서, 말 걸기 전에 얼른 자리를 떴어요.
Off the Rails#410.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#411.src: I headed down to the passenger carriages and spoke to everyone I saw. I was a little stressed, so I don't remember the specifics.
Off the Rails#411.dst: 승객 칸으로 내려가서 보이는 분마다 말을 걸었어요. 좀 정신없어서 자세한 건 기억이 안 나요.
Off the Rails#411.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#412.src: Well, not everyone, I suppose. You were asleep. Malic and I had a chuckle about it.
Off the Rails#412.dst: 음, 모두는 아니네요. 손님은 주무시고 계셨죠. Malic 씨랑 그걸 보고 좀 웃었어요.
Off the Rails#412.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#413.src: I also didn't speak to the guards... One was asleep in the same carriage as you, and the other started walking towards the back carriage when I came by.
Off the Rails#413.dst: 경비병들하고도 얘기 안 했어요... 한 명은 손님이랑 같은 칸에서 자고 있었고, 다른 한 명은 제가 지나갈 때 뒤 칸 쪽으로 걸어갔어요.
Off the Rails#413.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#414.src: I made my way back to the back and encountered Demma and Cemor on the way back to their seats. I made sure to dash by Cemor.
Off the Rails#414.dst: 다시 뒤쪽으로 가다가 자리로 돌아가던 Demma 씨와 Cemor 씨를 마주쳤어요. Cemor 씨 옆은 잽싸게 지나갔죠.
Off the Rails#414.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#415.src: I was going back to loitering when suddenly, the purple guard came barging in shouting for his compatriot, who was in the bathroom.
Off the Rails#415.dst: 다시 서성이러 가려는데, 갑자기 보라색 경비병이 뛰어 들어와서 화장실에 있던 동료를 소리쳐 부르더라고요.
Off the Rails#415.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#416.src: Concerned, I followed the two of them, to find that they has found Levi's corpse. Before I could ask questions, they were off running through the train yelling.
Off the Rails#416.dst: 걱정돼서 두 사람을 따라갔더니 Levi 장군님 시신을 발견한 거였어요. 제가 뭘 묻기도 전에 소리치며 열차를 뛰어다니더라고요.
Off the Rails#416.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#418.src: Sure, I do have a master key for all rooms I can lend you. Let me find it...
Off the Rails#418.dst: 그럼요, 모든 방을 여는 마스터키가 있는데 빌려 드릴게요. 찾아볼게요...
Off the Rails#418.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#419.src: ...W-Whuh? Where is it? I always keep it somewhere in my pocket! Perhaps I dropped it somewhere?
Off the Rails#419.dst: ...어, 어? 어디 갔지? 늘 주머니 어딘가에 넣어 두는데! 어디 떨어뜨렸나?
Off the Rails#419.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#420.src: Oh no... Maybe the killer stole it! Maybe that's how they got into the room!
Off the Rails#420.dst: 안 돼... 범인이 훔쳐 갔나 봐요! 그렇게 방에 들어갔을지도요!
Off the Rails#420.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#421.src: ...Oh, no no no no... It can't be my fault... It can't...
Off the Rails#421.dst: ...아, 안 돼 안 돼 안 돼... 제 잘못일 리 없어... 그럴 리가...
Off the Rails#421.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#422.src: Please, you must find that key. It must be on the train somewhere.
Off the Rails#422.dst: 제발 그 열쇠를 찾아 주세요. 분명 열차 어딘가에 있을 거예요.
Off the Rails#422.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#423.src: Wait, You did? But I have it right h-
Off the Rails#423.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#424.src: ...W-Whuh? I guess I must have dropped it at some point.
Off the Rails#424.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#425.src: Oh no... Maybe the killer stole it! Maybe that's how they got into the room!
Off the Rails#425.dst: 안 돼... 범인이 훔쳐 갔나 봐요! 그렇게 방에 들어갔을지도요!
Off the Rails#425.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#426.src: Feel free to use it as needed for your investigation... You're free to enter the janitor's closet.
Off the Rails#426.dst: 수사에 필요하면 마음껏 쓰세요... 청소 도구실에 들어가셔도 돼요.
Off the Rails#426.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#427.src: Oh, thank goodness you found it. Thank you so much.
Off the Rails#427.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#428.src: Feel free to use it anywhere you need. You may even enter the janitor's closet, if you'd like.
Off the Rails#428.dst: 필요한 곳 어디든 쓰세요. 원하시면 청소 도구실에 들어가셔도 돼요.
Off the Rails#428.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#429.src: A book? In the closet? Hm, I'm not much of a reader, so I doubt it was mine...
Off the Rails#429.dst: 책이요? 도구실에? 음, 전 책을 잘 안 읽어서 제 건 아닐 거예요...
Off the Rails#429.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#430.src: ...It was used to hide the knife, you say? That's... worrying.
Off the Rails#430.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#431.src: Perhaps the murderer used the closet as something of a staging ground for their attack...
Off the Rails#431.dst: 범인이 도구실을 범행 준비 장소처럼 썼을지도 모르겠어요...
Off the Rails#431.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#432.src: Oh, no, did he really not forget? Damnit. Damnit damnit damnit.
Off the Rails#432.dst: 아, 안 돼, 정말 안 잊으셨대요? 젠장. 젠장 젠장 젠장.
Off the Rails#432.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#433.src: ...Listen. I'm- I'm really quite stressed, alright? I didn't think I'd be able to make that recipe before, let alone now.
Off the Rails#433.dst: ...들어 보세요. 저- 저 지금 스트레스가 엄청나거든요? 전에도 그 요리를 못 할 것 같았는데, 지금은 더하죠.
Off the Rails#433.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#434.src: I'm... I'm so sorry to ask you this, but... Could you please make the meal for him? He wanted whole roast Grookiva.
Off the Rails#434.dst: 저... 이런 부탁 정말 죄송한데... 그분 식사를 대신 만들어 주실래요? Grookiva 통구이를 원하셨어요.
Off the Rails#434.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#435.src: My absent colleagu, Zathie, left a recipe book that you can use. I'm sure you can follow it better than I ever could.
Off the Rails#435.dst: 자리에 없는 동료 Zathie가 남긴 요리책을 쓰시면 돼요. 분명 저보다 훨씬 잘 따라 하실 거예요.
Off the Rails#435.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#436.src: I give you my full permission to enter the kitchen for this task, it's in the canteen carriage. Thank you for this.
Off the Rails#436.dst: 이 일을 위해 주방 출입을 전적으로 허락할게요. 식당칸에 있어요. 정말 고마워요.
Off the Rails#436.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#437.src: Oh, alright then. Have a good trip!
Off the Rails#437.speaker: Telati

Off the Rails#438.src: Ugh, what is it now? (Initial conversations with Harvin and Maury)
Off the Rails#438.dst: 으, 이번엔 또 뭐야? (Harvin, Maury와의 첫 대화)
Off the Rails#438.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#439.src: None of it matters now, though. Anythin' else? (After asking about What were you doing on the train)
Off the Rails#439.dst: 근데 이제 다 소용없어. 또 있어? (열차에서 뭘 했는지 물은 후)
Off the Rails#439.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#440.src: Sorry, kid. Anythin' else to ask? (After asking about General Levi)
Off the Rails#440.dst: 미안하다, 꼬마. 또 물어볼 거 있어? (Levi 장군에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#440.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#441.src: Uh... Anythin' else ta say? (After asking about Where were you during the murder)
Off the Rails#441.dst: 어... 또 할 말 있어? (살인 때 어디 있었는지 물은 후)
Off the Rails#441.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#442.src: 's'all we got, though. Any other questions? (After asking about the Passengers)
Off the Rails#442.dst: 우리가 아는 건 그게 다야. 다른 질문은? (승객들에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#442.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#443.src: Anyway, Got any questions that'll actually help ya with the case? (After asking about the Deraj)
Off the Rails#443.dst: 아무튼, 사건에 진짜 도움 될 질문은 없어? (Deraj에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#443.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#444.src: ...anythin' else to say before ya get back to it? (After asking to make an accusation)
Off the Rails#444.dst: ...다시 조사하러 가기 전에 할 말 있어? (범인 지목을 요청한 후)
Off the Rails#444.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#445.src: Well, it was supposed to be a secret, until this dope let it slip. I s'pose we can just say it now, though.
Off the Rails#445.dst: 음, 원래 비밀이었는데 이 멍청이가 입을 놀렸지. 뭐, 이제 그냥 말해도 되겠지.
Off the Rails#445.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#446.src: We were travellin' to {p}, to investigate some sort of incident.
Off the Rails#446.dst: 우린 무슨 사건을 조사하러 {p}로 가던 중이었어.
Off the Rails#446.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#447.src: Apparently, someone got in and killed all the soldiers, plus Commander Lilles... Serious stuff.
Off the Rails#447.dst: 듣자 하니 누가 들어와서 병사를 몽땅 죽였대. Lilles 사령관까지... 심각한 일이지.
Off the Rails#447.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#448.src: She was called there because a lot of the people killed were Constables. That, and Sovereign Zhiraok was apparently desperate for some extra hands.
Off the Rails#448.dst: 죽은 사람 중에 치안대가 많아서 장군님이 불려 간 거야. 게다가 Zhiraok 군주도 일손이 절실했나 봐.
Off the Rails#448.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#449.src: Must be bad, if even he needs to ask for some help...
Off the Rails#449.dst: 그 양반까지 도움을 청할 정도면 상황이 안 좋은 거지...
Off the Rails#449.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#450.src: Tch, you think we studied this stuff? We don't know much about her.
Off the Rails#450.dst: 쯧, 우리가 그런 걸 공부했겠냐? 그분에 대해 아는 게 별로 없어.
Off the Rails#450.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#451.src: Yeah, all we knew was that she was our highest-ranking leader, aside from the Marshal, Majin.
Off the Rails#451.dst: 그래, 아는 거라곤 원수 Majin 빼고 우리 최고위 지휘관이라는 것뿐이었지.
Off the Rails#451.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#452.src: Well. Er. y'know, I got... tired. So I... took a nap.
Off the Rails#452.dst: 그게. 어. 그러니까, 내가... 피곤해서. 그래서... 낮잠을 좀 잤어.
Off the Rails#452.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#453.src: I TOLD you it would be a bad idea, Maury. There's a reason she brought two of us!
Off the Rails#453.dst: 그러니까 안 좋은 생각이라고 했잖아, Maury. 괜히 우리 둘을 데려오신 게 아니라고!
Off the Rails#453.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#454.src: Well- listen! Bein' made to come here in the morning right after workin' the night shift is a lot!
Off the Rails#454.dst: 야- 들어 봐! 야간 근무 끝나자마자 아침에 여기 끌려오는 게 보통 일이냐!
Off the Rails#454.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#455.src: Also, we had a deal. You were supposed ta keep watch while I slept, idiot!
Off the Rails#455.dst: 그리고 약속했잖아. 내가 자는 동안 네가 망봐야 했다고, 멍청아!
Off the Rails#455.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#456.src: Yeah, well... I needed the bathroom, alright? What was I supposed to do, go right there in my armor?
Off the Rails#456.dst: 그래, 근데... 화장실이 급했다고, 됐어? 갑옷 입은 채로 그 자리에서 쌀 수도 없잖아?
Off the Rails#456.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#457.src: Knowin' your smarts, I'm surprised ya didn't just do that anyway...
Off the Rails#457.dst: 네 머리로 그냥 그렇게 안 한 게 놀랍다...
Off the Rails#457.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#458.src: ...You were the one worried about screwing it up! Just think how that would have looked, dude, we would have been so fired!
Off the Rails#458.dst: ...망칠까 봐 걱정한 건 너잖아! 그랬으면 어땠겠냐, 우린 바로 잘렸을 거라고!
Off the Rails#458.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#459.src: OBVIOUSLY, I'M NOT SAYING YOU SHOULD HAVE DONE THAT, HARVIN. By the Queen, you really tire me, sometimes...
Off the Rails#459.dst: 당연히 그렇게 했어야 했다는 말이 아니잖아, HARVIN. 여왕님 맙소사, 너 가끔 진짜 피곤하다...
Off the Rails#459.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#460.src: But... Ya know... Ya coulda made some effort to... hold it in..?
Off the Rails#460.dst: 그래도... 있잖아... 좀... 참아 볼 수는 있었잖아..?
Off the Rails#460.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#461.src: You realize we're saying all of this in front of our detective, right..?
Off the Rails#461.dst: 우리 지금 탐정 앞에서 이 얘기 다 하고 있는 거 알지..?
Off the Rails#461.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#462.src: Whuh? Oh, yeah. You. Uh. Uhhh.
Off the Rails#462.dst: 어? 아, 그래. 너. 어. 어어.
Off the Rails#462.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#464.src: We've not spoken to any of 'em, so we don't really know a whole lot.
Off the Rails#464.dst: 우린 저 사람들이랑 한마디도 안 해 봐서 아는 게 별로 없어.
Off the Rails#464.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#465.src: I can vouch for the {p} guy. He was in the bathroom while I was waiting outside.
Off the Rails#465.dst: {p} 남자는 내가 보증할게. 내가 밖에서 기다리는 동안 화장실 안에 있었거든.
Off the Rails#465.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#466.src: Took his sweet time in there, I tell you... Maybe I would've been able to protect the General if he had been quicker.
Off the Rails#466.dst: 진짜 한참 걸리더라... 그 사람이 빨리 나왔으면 장군님을 지킬 수 있었을지도 몰라.
Off the Rails#466.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#467.src: I noticed that the one with the white shirt and red dress was weirdly quiet back when everyone was gathered around... I'm suspicious of 'em.
Off the Rails#467.dst: 흰 셔츠에 빨간 원피스 입은 사람이 다들 모였을 때 이상하게 조용하더라고... 수상해.
Off the Rails#467.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#468.src: Pal, you must really be kiddin' me. Are ya really tellin' me you've lived in Fruma yer whole life, and haven't heard of Deraj?
Off the Rails#468.dst: 이봐, 농담하는 거지. Fruma에서 평생 살았다면서 Deraj를 못 들어 봤다고?
Off the Rails#468.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#469.src: It's the big prison down in the aptly-named Penitence District to the south. Come on, everyone's heard of it...
Off the Rails#469.dst: 남쪽에 이름도 딱 맞는 Penitence District에 있는 큰 감옥이잖아. 에이, 모르는 사람이 어딨어...
Off the Rails#469.speaker: Harvin

Off the Rails#470.src: Not many people know it like we do, though... Not that we know much at all about it either.
Off the Rails#470.dst: 그래도 우리만큼 아는 사람은 별로 없지... 사실 우리도 거의 모르지만.
Off the Rails#470.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#471.src: They say the prisoners there live an alright life, that they're just kept out of the way of Fruman society fer everyone else's sake...
Off the Rails#471.dst: 거기 죄수들은 그럭저럭 괜찮게 산다더라. 모두를 위해 Fruma 사회에서 떨어뜨려 놓을 뿐이라고...
Off the Rails#471.speaker: Maury

Off the Rails#472.src: But, we've had several, er, acquaintances... who've ended up there. They never came back.

Off the Rails#641.dst: 있잖아요, 다른 말 하려고 했는데 까먹었잖아요!!!

Off the Rails#643.src: Maybe it'll clear your head if our friend here solves the crossword. Proves it's easy.

Off the Rails#657.dst: 전 늘 그 나무들 이름을 그렇게 붙인 게, 어, 정말 바보 같다고 생각했어요. 그런데 Maddison은 좋아하네요?

Off the Rails#658.src: Yep, and then it takes even more to hold on to it!
Off the Rails#658.dst: 맞아요, 그리고 그걸 붙잡고 있으려면 더 들죠!

Off the Rails#659.src: Oh, goodness, crossword... Don't make me think of that again...
Off the Rails#659.dst: 아, 세상에, 십자말풀이... 또 생각나게 하지 마세요...

Off the Rails#660.src: Man... heard that didn't go super well this year...
Off the Rails#660.dst: 아이고... 올해는 그게 잘 안 풀렸다더라고요...

Off the Rails#665.src: UGH, what????? Damnit! I guess I didn't pay good enough attention on my trip...
Off the Rails#665.dst: 으, 뭐라고요????? 젠장! 여행하면서 제대로 안 봤나 봐요...

Off the Rails#670.dst: 듣자 하니 특히 그 가문을 벼르는 사람들이 있대요... 제가 아는 건 그게 다예요, 죄송해요.

Off the Rails#671.src: ...That blasted attendant... He better give me m-
Off the Rails#671.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#672.src: ...Ah, you! You again. They let you go, hm?
Off the Rails#672.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#673.src: Lucky. Those Constables... Majin has them stationed around {p} for our safety, but they're always causing trouble. I don't trust people like them.
Off the Rails#673.dst: 운이 좋군. 그 치안대 놈들... Majin이 우리 안전을 위해 {p} 곳곳에 배치했지만, 늘 말썽이지. 그런 자들은 못 믿어.
Off the Rails#673.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#674.src: Still, I suppose Levi would have been different, given her high role. How cruel it is that someone cut her life short...
Off the Rails#674.dst: 그래도 Levi는 지위가 높으니 달랐겠지. 누군가 그녀의 삶을 끊어 버리다니 참 잔인하군...

Off the Rails#675.dst: 범인을 찾고 있지? 알아야 할 건 뭐든 말해 주지.

Off the Rails#676.src: ...That blasted attendant... He better give me m-

Off the Rails#677.src: ...Oh, it's you. You from the murder scene. They let you go, hm?
Off the Rails#677.dst: ...아, 자네로군. 살인 현장에 있던 자네. 풀려났나 보지?

Off the Rails#678.src: Lucky. Those Constables... Majin has them stationed around {p} for our safety, but they're always causing trouble. I don't trust people like them.
Off the Rails#678.dst: 운이 좋군. 그 치안대 놈들... Majin이 우리 안전을 위해 {p} 곳곳에 배치했지만, 늘 말썽이지. 그런 자들은 못 믿어.

Off the Rails#679.src: Still, I suppose Levi would have been different, given her high role. How cruel it is that someone cut her life short...
Off the Rails#679.dst: 그래도 Levi는 지위가 높으니 달랐겠지. 누군가 그녀의 삶을 끊어 버리다니 참 잔인하군...

Off the Rails#680.src: You are looking for the perpetrator, yes? I'll tell you anything you need to know. I suppose the first thing would be an introduction.
Off the Rails#680.dst: 범인을 찾고 있지? 알아야 할 건 뭐든 말해 주지. 우선 자기소개부터 해야겠군.

Off the Rails#681.src: I am Cemor, of House Efelu, a noble house of small repute, though soon it shall surely rise.
Off the Rails#681.dst: 난 Efelu 가문의 Cemor일세. 아직 명성은 크지 않은 귀족 가문이지만, 곧 분명 떠오를 걸세.
Off the Rails#681.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#682.src: I'm travelling from my home, the {p}, to Auburn. Why? Well, I booked a ticket to go to the Festival of the Queen, but... for the wrong date.
Off the Rails#682.dst: 고향인 {p}에서 Auburn으로 가는 길이네. 왜냐고? 음, 여왕 축제에 가려고 표를 예매했는데... 날짜를 잘못 골랐지.
Off the Rails#682.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#683.src: I didn't want that money to go to waste, so I'm going to go and visit {p} anyway. There's probably some festival left to experience.
Off the Rails#683.dst: 그 돈을 날리긴 싫어서 어쨌든 {p}에 가 보기로 했네. 즐길 만한 축제가 좀 남아 있겠지.
Off the Rails#683.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#684.src: But enough about little old me. You are here to ask questions. Go on.
Off the Rails#684.dst: 이 늙은이 얘긴 이쯤 하지. 자네는 질문하러 왔지. 해 보게.
Off the Rails#684.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#685.src: Go ahead, now. Ask away. (After initial conversation)
Off the Rails#685.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#686.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#687.src: What else have you to ask? (After asking about what Cemor saw before the murder)
Off the Rails#687.dst: 또 뭘 묻고 싶나? (살인 전에 Cemor가 본 것을 물은 후)
Off the Rails#687.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#688.src: But let us move on from that. Any more questions? (After asking about Constables)
Off the Rails#688.dst: 그 얘긴 이쯤 하세. 또 질문 있나? (치안대에 대해 물은 후)
Off the Rails#688.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#689.src: Any more questions? (After asking about what Cemor is mad about)
Off the Rails#689.dst: 또 질문 있나? (Cemor가 화난 이유를 물은 후)
Off the Rails#689.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#690.dst: 아무튼 식사 고맙네. 자, 질문이 있으면 하고, 없으면 식사하게 내버려 두게. (Cemor에게 식사를 준 후)
Off the Rails#690.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#691.src: I didn't see much at all, because I was in the bathroom for much of the time. There's only one thing I saw that could be of note.
Off the Rails#691.dst: 대부분 화장실에 있어서 거의 본 게 없네. 눈여겨볼 만한 건 딱 하나뿐이지.
Off the Rails#691.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#692.src: When I reached the back of the train, where the bathroom is located, I noticed the attendant, Telati.
Off the Rails#692.dst: 화장실이 있는 열차 맨 뒤에 갔을 때 승무원 Telati가 보였네.
Off the Rails#692.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#693.src: He was just stood around, up to... something. When he saw me enter, he seemed to panic and left the carriage. How suspicious.
Off the Rails#693.dst: 그냥 서서... 뭔가 꾸미고 있었지. 내가 들어오는 걸 보더니 당황해서 칸을 나가더군. 수상하기 짝이 없어.
Off the Rails#693.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#695.src: They're supposedly stronger than the regular divisional soldiers, but at least those divisional soldiers knew respect.
Off the Rails#695.dst: 일반 지역 부대 병사보다 강하다고들 하지만, 적어도 그 병사들은 예의를 알았네.
Off the Rails#695.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#696.src: The Constables are often from other regions, so they're not part of the local community- they're less friendly. This makes them HORRIBLE town guards.
Off the Rails#696.dst: 치안대는 대개 다른 지역 출신이라 지역 공동체에 속하지 않아서 덜 친절하지. 그래서 마을 경비로는 최악이야.
Off the Rails#696.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#697.src: I speak from experience. Our Sovereign, Majin, replaced the {p} guard with Constables a few years ago. Supposedly to better protect us.
Off the Rails#697.dst: 경험에서 하는 말일세. 우리 군주 Majin이 몇 년 전 {p} 경비대를 치안대로 바꿨지. 우릴 더 잘 지킨다나.
Off the Rails#697.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#698.src: Given his lack of improvements to the town besides that, I doubt that's the real reason. He just did it for the praise.
Off the Rails#698.dst: 그 외엔 마을을 전혀 개선하지 않은 걸 보면 진짜 이유는 아닐 걸세. 그냥 칭찬받으려고 한 거지.
Off the Rails#698.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#699.src: If he REALLY wanted to please us, he should have had some of those spangly Wings guard us. They don't do anything but stand around looking cool, anyway.
Off the Rails#699.dst: 정말 우릴 만족시키고 싶었다면 번쩍번쩍한 날개단을 붙여 줬어야지. 어차피 폼 잡고 서 있는 것 말곤 하는 일도 없잖나.
Off the Rails#699.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#700.src: They're the best of the best, and I'm sure they would serve us better than those unruly Constables. They have the decorum not to scoff in our faces.
Off the Rails#700.dst: 그들은 최정예니 제멋대로인 치안대보다 분명 우릴 더 잘 섬길 걸세. 우리 면전에서 비웃지 않을 품위도 있고.
Off the Rails#700.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#701.src: Yes, that's right- scoff in our faces. That's how little respect these Constables have for the nobility. It's ridiculous.
Off the Rails#701.dst: 그래, 맞네. 면전에서 비웃었지. 치안대가 귀족을 그 정도로밖에 존중하지 않는다네. 어처구니없지.
Off the Rails#701.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#702.src: A friend of mine, from House Krisa, was humiliated by a pair of rude Constables in {p} a while back. His handmade clothes were ruined! Covered in dye!
Off the Rails#702.dst: Krisa 가문의 친구가 얼마 전 {p}에서 무례한 치안대 둘에게 망신을 당했네. 손수 지은 옷이 망가졌지! 염료 범벅이 됐다고!
Off the Rails#702.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#703.src: He had one of his friends in House Liftal contact Majin about it, so I'm sure those fools got what they deserved... Heh.
Off the Rails#703.dst: 그 친구가 Liftal 가문 지인을 통해 Majin에게 연락했으니, 그 멍청이들은 응분의 대가를 치렀겠지... 흥.
Off the Rails#703.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#704.src: ...Anyway. All of this to say: Constables are no good. I am not fond of them.
Off the Rails#704.dst: ...아무튼. 결론은 이거네. 치안대는 쓸모없어. 난 그자들이 싫네.
Off the Rails#704.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#705.src: Ugh. It's that attendant, Telati. I asked him for a meal hours ago, and he STILL hasn't even STARTED on it!
Off the Rails#705.dst: 으. 그 승무원 Telati 말일세. 몇 시간 전에 식사를 주문했는데 아직 시작도 안 했어!
Off the Rails#705.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#706.src: ...Could you do me a favour go and ask him to get a move on? I'm tired of waiting here.
Off the Rails#706.dst: ...가서 서두르라고 좀 전해 주겠나? 여기서 기다리는 것도 지쳤네.
Off the Rails#706.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#707.src: You..? You made it? He reallu had you do it for him???
Off the Rails#707.dst: 자네가..? 자네가 만들었다고? 정말 대신 시켰단 말인가???
Off the Rails#707.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#708.src: Goodness... I'm going to be leaving a poor review of this train in the paper, and telling my friends of this disappointment...
Off the Rails#708.dst: 세상에... 신문에 이 열차 혹평을 남기고, 친구들한테도 이 실망스러운 일을 알려야겠군...
Off the Rails#708.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#709.src: ...Speaking of gossip, I thought of something I heard recently that might be useful to you...
Off the Rails#709.dst: ...소문 얘기가 나와서 말인데, 최근에 들은 것 중 자네한테 쓸모 있을 만한 게 생각났네...
Off the Rails#709.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#710.src: Yes, I heard from some friends that General Levi was being called to {p} by Sovereign Zhiraok.
Off the Rails#710.dst: 그래, 친구들한테 들었는데 Levi 장군이 Zhiraok 군주의 부름으로 {p}에 가는 중이었다더군.
Off the Rails#710.speaker: Cemor

Off the Rails#711.src: Of course, I'm sure you already knew that. My point is this- word was out about what was happening, so I bet whoever killed her had this insider information.
Off the Rails#711.dst: 물론 자네도 이미 알겠지. 요점은 이걸세. 무슨 일인지 소문이 났으니 그녀를 죽인 자는 분명 이 내부 정보를 알았을 거야.
